title: Alweeda Alweeda jaane khairul bashar
body:
Alweeda Alweeda
Jane Khairul Basher
Alweeda Alweeda
Asghar-e-bezuba Akbar-e-noujawan
<<DIVIDER>>
Maa Chali Apne Ghar Alweeda Alweeda
Khake Barchi Ka Phal Buch Gaya Shai Ka Dil
Phat Chukka Hai Jigar Alweeda Alweda
Dulha Pamal Hai Bewa Be Haal Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Kahete Hai Nouhagar Alweeda Alweda
Khoon Me Ta- Ba-Tar Ghazi Ka Hai Ye Sar
So Gaya Qakh Par Alweeda Alweda
Peet Te Apne Sar Bhai Ke Lash Par
<<DIVIDER>>
Shai Huwe Nouhagar Alweeda Alweda
Khoon-e-abbas Me Bar Chuka Hai Alam
Dekhiye Ek Nazar Alweeda Alweda
Lut Chuki Bibiya Qaid Ha Natawa
<<DIVIDER>>
Chal Chuke Katou Par Alweeda Alweda
Ek Zindan Hai Tu Jo Mehmaan Hai
Shai Ke Noor-e-nazar Alweeda Alweda
Gham Se Be Hal Hai Tera Iqbal Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaj Hai Nouhagar Alweeda Alweda
